items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. To świetna okazja, by sprawdzić swoją wytrzymałość, koncentrację i zmierzyć się z wyzwaniem, którego nie spotyka się na co dzień. Jeśli blindy to Wasza pasja (albo chcecie wreszcie poczuć ich klimat na poważnie) – widzimy się w Rzeszowie! --- We are excited to invite you to Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – a competition dedicated entirely to blindfolded events! 🙈 This is a true marathon: the schedule includes only blindfolded events, and on top of that something truly rare – two rounds of big cube blindfolded solving. It’s a perfect opportunity to test your endurance, focus, and face a challenge you don’t get to see very often. If blindfolded solving is your passion (or you simply want to dive into its atmosphere for real) – see you in Rzeszów!

items.name: Please Be Quiet Waterloo 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events*** and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Please see the **Locations** tab for more information. Please note that only the 3x3x3 Fewest Moves will be held officially - this is not an ideal competition for newcomers or those who only know speedsolving. Fewest Moves is comprised of 3 separate 1-hour attempts to solve the cube in the lowest possible number of moves. By WCA regulations, the puzzle must be solved in 80 moves or less (excluding rotations) in order to be a valid attempt, otherwise the result will be DNF. If you cannot solve the puzzle in 80 moves or less, please consider not registering for this event. There will be a short break in between attempts for grading, as well as snack/tea breaks for competitors. **GUESTS** Please note that guests and spectators are NOT welcome at this competition, unless special arrangements have been made prior to the event with the competition organisers (for example, for younger competitors that require a parent or guardian present). The venues are small and there must be absolute silence for the duration of each attempt.

items.name: Trondheim Høst 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Høst 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Høst 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimHost2025/#63531-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada) ATENÇÃO: Inscrições no local serão válidas apenas para o evento 3x3x3 e Pyraminx. Pedimos também atenção ao fato de que quando cada pessoa for entrar na universidade será necessário fazer um cadastro rápido na portaria. A universidade pede esse cadastro como medida de segurança. (EN) Welcome to the second Unidavi ao Cubo (2025) Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_ Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.) ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events. Also we want to point out that before each person gets in the university they will need to make a quick registration at the entrance. The university demands this registration for safety standards.
